summary: Paranoid American shared the exact prompt used with Claude to generate, composite, and animate a complete music video for their song "Deep Dish".

post.originalText:
"Deep Dish" (music video)

I'm beyond impressed with what AI can do now.

This was a one-shot music video using Claude Opus 5.5, all I provided was the song, lyrics and a short prompt (in comments below).

It took 67 minutes total. No post-production at all. No art provided. https://t.co/6KTvXvx5T0

sourceMaterials.text: @vehementstudios Already cooking on more now. This is where all my extra tokens will be going
sourceMaterials.author: ParanoidAmerica

sourceMaterials.text:
entire prompt:

create a music video for this entire song, check lyrics.txt to sync the visuals to. style should be a mix between monty-python/vox style "postcards in space" mixed with sketchy ballpoint pen style visuals. this needs to look professional. theme of the video is a creepy evil pizza parlor, camera starts outside and works through the inside, through a secret bookshelf door into a basement with untold horrors and pizza sauce all over the place. use whatever tools or methods you need to make this look professional. final export should be an .mp4 of the entire music video.

claude/opus 5.5 detected comfyui on my system, generated all the assets with SDXL and then composited and animated it all together.

Even if I had all of the art assets and timeline markers, this would have easily taken be 8-10+ hours in After Effects to do manually.

I might never open After Effects again.
